Although she seems like the cool type, Kyouko is actually more of a doting older sister to those she meets.
Recently, Kyouko has been faltering in her idol activities due to strenuous school work.

A healthy and simple teenager, Majime Masato is a guy who is constantly thinking about girls and his fantasies. Despite his hormones guiding his thoughts, he is a decent person underneath (unless the player chooses the more amoral events where he takes advantage of less willing girls outside his schoolmates).

One day he sees a small black cat being harassed by children. Masato takes action and saves the cat—the critter thanks him with words. It turns out the cat is a magical being and offers her gratitude by bestowing Masato with a smartphone capable of fulfilling his fantasies, a gift he accepts with joy.

Masato is the head of an unofficial school club, the Black Pantyhose Lovers Club, where he dragged some of his classmates to be part of it. He is infamous around school for being a super pervert but Masato still follows the line of SQUEEZ's protagonists where they are already well acquainted with much of the female cast from the get go; they all get along with him to varying degrees, even those who claim he is a good for nothing pervert.

In her third year of high school, Misaki is the daughter of the owners of a long-established Japanese confectionery shop, and is part of the Tea Ceremony Club.
She recently opened her own confectionary shop, called "Amanekoan", in the food court of the school, which operates in the Tea Ceremony Club.
Misaki is a fluffy, unfussy young woman.
Although she is in charge of the Tea Ceremony Club, sometimes her leadership comes into question (she sometimes spikes her own green tea, and is an "affectionate drunk").
Misaki also seems to be into some weird occult stuff, and gives her menu items some "creative" names.

However, when she is alone with the protagonist, her personality does a complete 180, which is at least a pleasant surprise.
She sees Kyouko as her rival as an idol, but secretly is a huge fan of her work, and is her number 1 supporter.
Affiliation: Ichisakura School second year, Class President
Shouko is one of the protagonist's classmates, as well as the president of their class after the protagonist suggested it as a joke (she nominated the protagonist to be Vice President).
With her great communication skills and confidence in public speaking, she runs the class efficiently and effectively.
As such she is often butting heads with Riko, who is the complete opposite of her, and yet is the student council president.
Shouko also heavily romanticizes gay relationships, as seen when she imagines Tsubasa (who she believes is a boy) and the protagonist in explicit situations.
Shouko also has some kind of immunity to the Ero Appli.
